---

## 1. Company Overview
NK Laser is a premier Indian industrial supplier specializing in direct import and distribution of precision fiber laser cutting consumables, high-transmittance laser optics, and CNC control systems for high-power fiber laser cutting machines (1kW to 30kW). Additionally, NK Laser operates high-precision sheet metal and pipe CNC fiber laser cutting and fabrication job-work facilities.

---

## 2. Core Spare Parts & Optics Portfolio

### Optical Protective Windows & Lenses
- **Fused Silica / Quartz Protective Windows**: High damage threshold (anti-reflective AR coated at 1064nm, >99.95% transmittance, dual-side dielectric coating).
- **Common Sizes**: 
  - D27.9 x 4.1mm (RayTools BM110, BM111, BM06K)
  - D30 x 5mm (RayTools BM114, OSPRI LC40/LC60)
  - D37 x 7mm (High power 12kW-30kW OSPRI, WSX, Precitec ProCutter)
  - D24.9 x 1.5mm / D20 x 2mm / D38 x 8mm
- **Focusing & Collimating Lens Assemblies**: Doublet achromatic lenses with low wave-front distortion, optimized for RayTools, WSX, and Precitec heads.

### Laser Cutting Nozzles
- **Material**: High-conductivity Tellurium Copper (TeCu C14500) with mirror-smooth interior surface finish for laminar gas flow.
- **Configurations**: Single layer (Nitrogen/Air assist for Stainless Steel & Aluminum), Double layer (Oxygen assist for Mild Steel), Chromed/Electroplated high-durability coatings.
- **Aperture Diameters**: 1.0mm, 1.2mm, 1.4mm, 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2.0mm, 2.5mm, 3.0mm, 3.5mm, 4.0mm.
- **Thread Standards**: M11, M14, M16, D28mm, D32mm (RayTools, Precitec, WSX, Bystronic, Trumpf compatible).

### Ceramic Sensor Bodies & Rings
- **Material**: High-purity technical alumina ceramic with soldered gold-plated alloy contacts.
- **Function**: Capacitive height sensing and collision detection between laser head and sheet metal.
- **Models**: RayTools D28/D32 ceramic rings, Precitec ceramic bodies, OSPRI capacitive rings.

### Cutting Heads & CNC Controller Hardware
- **Cutting Heads**: RayTools BM110, BM111, BM114S, OSPRI LC40, LC60, LC80, WSX NC30, NC60 autofocus heads.
- **CNC Controllers**: BOCHU CypCut FSCUT2000E, FSCUT4000E, FSCUT8000 bus system controllers.
- **Wireless Remotes**: CypCut WKC wireless industrial operator pendants.
- **Pneumatics & Sensors**: High-pressure proportional valves (SMC/Aventics), centering target needles, water and gas fittings.

---

## 3. Compatible Machine & Laser Source Brands
NK Laser spares guarantee 100% fitment with:
- **Laser Cutting Heads**: RayTools, OSPRI, WSX, Precitec, Au3Tech, Bodor Genius, WSX, DNE.
- **CNC Systems**: BOCHU FSCUT (CypCut / CypOne / HypCut), Weihong, CypTube.
- **Fiber Laser Sources**: IPG Photonics, Raycus, Maxphotonics, nLIGHT, JPT, GW Laser.
- **Machine OEMs**: Bodor, HSG, DNE Global, Hans Laser, HGTECH, Lead Laser, Penta Laser, Sahajanand Laser (SLTL), Mehta CAD CAM, Macpower.

---

## 4. Engineering & Laser Cutting Services

- **CNC Sheet Metal Fiber Laser Cutting**:
  - Mild Steel / Carbon Steel: Up to 25mm thickness (Oxygen & High-Pressure Nitrogen)
  - Stainless Steel (SS304/SS316): Up to 20mm thickness (Burr-free nitrogen cutting)
  - Aluminum (5052/6061): Up to 16mm thickness
  - Brass & Pure Copper: Up to 10mm thickness
- **CNC Tube & Rotary Pipe Laser Cutting**: Round pipes (up to 220mm OD), square tubes (up to 150x150mm), rectangular and C-channels.
- **CNC Press Brake Bending**: Multi-axis sheet metal forming up to 3000mm bend length.
- **Precision Laser Welding & Assembly**: Fiber handheld laser welding for spotless, high-strength joints.
- **Architectural & Decorative Metal Jali**: Custom CNC cut façade panels, railings, and screens.
